tools.name: sessions_list
tools.description: List local coding-agent sessions (Claude Code, Codex, Pi, OpenCode), newest first: id, agent, project, model, message count, estimated cost, size, update time and title. Use an id with sessions_analyze.

project.description: Project name (Claude/Pi slug, or cwd basename for Codex/OpenCode)

since.description: Only sessions updated since: ISO date (2026-01-31, UTC) or relative 7d, 12h, 2w

cwd.description: Only sessions run in this directory or below; `~` is the home dir, relative paths resolve against the server's cwd

format.description: text (default): compact tab-separated tables; json: the same payload as the CLI's --json

tools.name: sessions_search
tools.description: Find sessions whose transcript contains a phrase (case-insensitive, literal), newest first. Returns each session's id, agent, project, update time, match count and the first matching lines as redacted snippets. Use an id with sessions_analyze.

project.description: Project name (Claude/Pi slug, or cwd basename for Codex/OpenCode)

since.description: Only sessions updated since: ISO date (2026-01-31, UTC) or relative 7d, 12h, 2w

format.description: text (default): compact tab-separated tables; json: the same payload as the CLI's --json

tools.name: sessions_analyze
tools.description: Context-budget forensics for one session: verdict, peak and final context, turns, tool calls, estimated cost and the token budget at peak. Pass an id (short id works), or latest:true, or a cwd to pick the newest session there.

id.description: Session id, short id, or transcript path

latest.description: Analyze the newest session of any agent

cwd.description: Only sessions run in this directory or below; `~` is the home dir, relative paths resolve against the server's cwd

parent.description: Parent session id, when id is a subagent transcript (agent-*)

format.description: text (default): compact tab-separated tables; json: the same payload as the CLI's --json

tools.name: stats_report
tools.description: Cross-session friction report: what to fix first, named causes of retries, what fails and what costs time, with suggested rules for CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md. Each row has a DRILL cell such as `--cause K`; expand it with stats_drill.

format.description: text (default): compact tab-separated tables; json: the same payload as the CLI's --json

tools.name: stats_drill
tools.description: The calls behind one stats_report row. A DRILL cell `--cause K` maps to {table:"cause", key:"K"}; likewise --fail and --time.

key.description: Key from the DRILL cell, without the --table prefix

format.description: text (default): compact tab-separated tables; json: the same payload as the CLI's --json
